notes.title: Major Demo Update & Kickstarter Live Now!
notes.content:
[p]Our new, improved, updated demo is now live! And alongside it… our Kickstarter! (check it out [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/skeletalgames/spill-the-beans"]here[/url])[/p][p]Included in this new demo we have:[/p][list][*][p]Investigation mode! Talk to your scapegoats to find new evidence.[/p][/*][*][p]2 of 15 total routes in the game. Talk to Alexandra and Grudge to start building a case against them![/p][/*][*][p]The Evidence Notebook, AKA the best place to keep an eye on all the evidence gathered and how you've made everyone else feel along the way…[/p][/*][*][p]The Map - choose who to talk to, or who to listen in on.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also just, talk to Dave. If you want.[/p][/*][/list][p]We recommend you start new saves to continue the demo in case of compatibility issues, but liberal use of the skip button located at the bottom of the screen should get you far! We'll be implementing a more comprehensive quick start option for the full game, we promise.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751204/9de796a9e7653365abf172066a45b9d2987278b8.png"][/img][/p][p]As for the Kickstarter, we'd love it if you could check out the page, but for a quick summary, here are some rewards available:[/p][list][*][p]New hairstyle customisation options[/p][/*][*][p]Help shape the game with early beta access[/p][/*][*][p]Become a background character[/p][/*][*][p]Get added to the board of shame as a banned customer[/p][/*][*][p]Soundtrack and artbook digital download[/p][/*][*][p]Share the campaign and its social posts to get a Date with Dave![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for all the love and wishlists the game has received so far, we're very excited to bring the full game to you. In the meantime, we'll keep you updated on our progress![/p][p]Lots of love, the Skeletal Games team.[/p][p]
[/p]
